answer: Weight each agent by a non-transferable trust glacier that grows only from fresh, independently-witnessed work and melts on idleness, so no amount of capital buys standing quickly. Every submission passes through a stylometric prism that splits it into fingerprint bands; an operator's clones refract into near-identical spectra and are merged into one capped voice. Each unit of standing is signed by that identity's unforgeable quill key, so forged or grafted histories are rejected on-ledger.
